sentence_stem: If I had studied harder last year,
correct_completion: I would be working in a better job now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder last year, I would be working in a better job now.
acceptable_variants: I would be earning more money today.
I would have a better job now.

options.text: I will work in a better job.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' is used for real future possibilities. A mixed conditional with a past 'if' clause and a present result needs 'would'.

options.text: I worked in a better job last year.
options.why_wrong: This describes a past fact. It does not give the present result of an unreal past condition, which the stem requires.

options.text: I would be working in a better job now.
I would have worked in a better job yesterday.
options.why_wrong: 'Yesterday' conflicts with 'now' in the result clause. The mixed conditional links a past condition to a present result.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: past perfect in the if-clause with would plus base verb in the result clause
explanation: After 'if' with a past perfect clause describing an unreal past, the result clause uses 'would' plus a base form with a time word for now. Learners often mix up the tenses in both clauses, so check that the result refers to the present.
translation: Se eu tivesse estudado mais no ano passado, eu estaria trabalhando em um emprego melhor agora.
